source_refs.note: Exercise 4.3, Q4 (a)-(c), Half-Life box; book page 139

blocks.prompt: 4 (a) A radioactive isotope has a half-life of 12 hours. The initial mass is 160 grams. What is the decay constant?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh radioactive decay ka sawal hai, model \(\frac{dM}{dt} = -kM\).
Diya kya hai? Shuru ka mass 160 g aur half-life 12 ghante. Half-Life box ke mutabiq iska matlab hai ke 12 ghante mein mass aadha, yani 80 g, reh jata hai: \(M(12) = 80\).
Find kya karna hai? Decay constant \(k\).
Plan: solution banayein aur \(M(12) = 80\) se \(k\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(M(0) = 160\) g; half-life 12 ghante, is liye \(M(12) = 80\) g.
Maloom karna: decay constant \(k\).
Tareeqa: decay model; Half-Life box batata hai ke ek half-life ke baad mass shuru wale mass ka aadha hota hai. Yahi doosri condition ban jati hai.

Decay model hal karein
\[\dfrac{dM}{dt} = -kM\]
\[M = ce^{-kt}\]
\[M(0) = 160 \Rightarrow c = 160\]
\[M = 160e^{-kt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya aur \(e\) liya (Example 10 ki tarah). \(t = 0\) par \(e^{0} = 1\), is liye \(c\) shuru wala mass 160 hai.

\(M(12) = 80\) lagayein
\[80 = 160e^{-12k}\]
\[e^{-12k} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[12k = \ln 2\]
\[k = \dfrac{\ln 2}{12} \approx 0.05776\]
Kyun: 160 se divide kiya, phir \(\ln\) liya: \(\ln\frac{1}{2} = -\ln 2\), dono minus cancel. \(\ln 2 \approx 0.693147\), is ko 12 se divide kiya. Yahi half-life wala formula \(k = \frac{\ln 2}{T_{1/2}}\) hai.
Dhyan dein: half-life ko seedha k samajh lena (k = 12) bohat aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[160e^{-0.05776(12)} = 160e^{-0.6931} \approx 80 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 12 ghante baad mass sach mein aadha aa raha hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (b) A radioactive isotope has a half-life of 12 hours. The initial mass is 160 grams. How much mass will remain after 36 hours?
blocks.explanation:
Wohi model \(M = 160e^{-kt}\), aur \(k = \frac{\ln 2}{12}\) part (a) se.
Find kya karna hai? 36 ghante baad bacha hua mass, \(M(36)\).
Pehle hi andaza laga lein: 36 ghante = 3 half-lives, to mass teen dafa aadha hoga.
Plan: \(t = 36\) rakhein aur \(e^{-12k} = \frac{1}{2}\) ka faida uthayein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(M = 160e^{-kt}\), \(k = \frac{\ln 2}{12}\) (part (a) se).
Maloom karna: \(M(36)\).
Tareeqa: \(t = 36\) rakhenge aur \(e^{-12k} = \frac{1}{2}\) bilkul theek value istemal karenge, taa ke rounding ka masla na ho.

Decay model hal karein
\[\dfrac{dM}{dt} = -kM\]
\[M = ce^{-kt}\]
\[M(0) = 160 \Rightarrow c = 160\]
\[M = 160e^{-kt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya aur \(e\) liya (Example 10 ki tarah). \(t = 0\) par \(e^{0} = 1\), is liye \(c\) shuru wala mass 160 hai.

Tasdeeq
Half-lives gin kar: \(160 \to 80\) (12 h) \(\to 40\) (24 h) \(\to 20\) (36 h) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: har 12 ghante mein mass aadha; dono tareeqon se 20 gram.

blocks.prompt: 4 (c) A radioactive isotope has a half-life of 12 hours. The initial mass is 160 grams. After how many hours will only 10 grams remain?
blocks.explanation:
Wohi model, lekin ab ulta sawal: mass \(M = 10\) g diya hai aur waqt \(t\) maloom karna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(M = 160e^{-kt}\), \(k = \frac{\ln 2}{12}\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(t\) jab \(M = 10\).
Plan: \(160e^{-kt} = 10\) likh kar \(e^{-kt}\) akela karein, phir \(\ln\) lein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(M = 160e^{-kt}\), \(k = \frac{\ln 2}{12}\); \(M = 10\) g.
Maloom karna: \(t\).
Tareeqa: \(M = 10\) rakh kar \(e^{-kt}\) ko akela karenge aur \(\ln\) lenge.

Decay model hal karein
\[\dfrac{dM}{dt} = -kM\]
\[M = ce^{-kt}\]
\[M(0) = 160 \Rightarrow c = 160\]
\[M = 160e^{-kt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya aur \(e\) liya (Example 10 ki tarah). \(t = 0\) par \(e^{0} = 1\), is liye \(c\) shuru wala mass 160 hai.

\(M = 10\) rakhein
\[10 = 160e^{-kt}\]
\[e^{-kt} = \dfrac{1}{16}\]
\[kt = \ln 16 = 4\ln 2\]
Kyun: 160 se divide kiya, phir \(\ln\) liya: \(\ln\frac{1}{16} = -\ln 16\). \(16 = 2^{4}\) hai, is liye \(\ln 16 = 4\ln 2\).

\(t\) nikalein
\[t = \dfrac{4\ln 2}{k} = \dfrac{4\ln 2}{\ln 2 / 12}\]
\[t = 48\]
Kyun: \(\ln 2\) upar aur neeche se cancel ho gaya aur \(4 \times 12 = 48\) bacha.

Tasdeeq
Chaar half-lives: \(160 \to 80 \to 40 \to 20 \to 10\), yani \(4 \times 12 = 48\) ghante \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: half-life ke hisaab se bhi wohi jawab aaya.
